name: María Corina Machado
scope: Independent MCM-only audit. Only this report and tests/character-audits/mcm.test.ts were written; no runtime or art edits.

sourceRevision.head: 2273843fe788fb68bfa35d80d9ec87b48f1d2b7e
sourceRevision.workingTree: Shared implementation is untracked in this repository; hashes identify the actual reviewed files. Fresh tsx rerun followed shared changes during the audit.

validation.engine: Real shared/engine.ts with seed mcm-v28-audit; no mocks.

setup.targetX: MCM x plus gap on side 0, minus gap on side 1

movement.inputs: At x=540, hold right 24 frames, then left 24 frames; release 10; jump, advance 10, jump, advance 1, third jump, advance 1, then advance 100.
movement.facing: Movement faces its input; idle grounded facing returns toward the rival.

ordinaryAttacks.result: pass on both sides at gap 80

light.input: Increment light once, advance 8 frames, then 40

heavy.input: Increment heavy once, advance 13 frames, then 40

ordinaryAttacks.frontGuard: Both attacks leave target HP at 100 and produce one block response; neither repeats damage. Knockback direction follows the attacker side.

special.name: Marcha firme
special.result: pass on both sides with the current moving active window and expiry braking
special.inputs: Gap 280. Increment special once at tick 510, advance 80 input frames. Idle target uses empty input; front target holds block; rear target holds block plus movement away from MCM throughout.

rangeProbes.inputs: One special, then 100 empty-input frames on both sides

special.energyGate: 24 energy rejects special on either side.

combos.whiffRecognition: At gap 140, light, 23 frames, light, 23 frames, heavy, 11 frames. Both lights whiff and the heavy recognizes the existing input chain.

connectedBase.input: Light then heavy with approach inputs after knockback

connectedUpgraded.input: Light, light, heavy with approach inputs after knockback

cpuBout.inputs: MCM waits 180 frames, chases beyond gap 85, uses super below gap 230 at energy >=75, rally at gaps 180..345 with energy >=25, light/heavy below gap 145, situational block and jumps; rival uses cpuInput every frame.
cpuBout.deterministicReplay: Complete final state and started/landed attack records match exactly on two fresh seeded executions.

visual.method: Native T3 preview_status followed by preview_open with reuseExistingTab:false. Actual game loadSprite/drawSprite, drawPresentation and drawIntroCinematic imported into the owned localhost:5173 page for deterministic inspection.
visual.identity: All eight poses preserve the dossier's elongated adult face, dark long straight hair, white collared shirt, dark jeans, brown belt and white shoes. Full silhouettes are coherent at game scale; no detached neighbor shoe fragments were visible. Arcade anatomy is preserved.
visual.selection: Inspected 0, 840, 1680, 2800 and 5600 ms in both facings. Saludo de encuentro occurs once and holds battle frame 1 afterward; pixel equality confirms the final guard is unchanged after the duration.
visual.intro: Inspected cinematic progress 0.3, 0.65 and 1 on both player sides; MCM faces inward and returns to guard. Intro input locks and final rival facings are also tested in the engine.

browserEntranceQA.command: auditEntrances(['mcm']) from /scripts/entrance-browser-qa.ts in the owned native tab

visual.limitations: Visual inspection used deterministic renderer snapshots and pixel checks, not a continuous manually controlled fight. Audio listening was not part of this audit.

conclusion: No current reproducible MCM-specific defect found. Rally delayed contact and braking are verified on both sides; ordinary attacks, movement, combo/super gates, deterministic CPU fight, likeness, inward facing and one-shot presentations pass.
